rulings.challenge_claim: 24:29 'shares no root' with 24:30's sluggard vignette is bytes-false; rejected_alternative never tests the backward merge with 24:28.
rulings.grounds: Byte re-derivation (tier-1, oshb:Prov.24.29/Prov.24.30) confirms the root איש recurs across the row's own forward seam: v29 closes with לָאִ֣ישׁ ("to the man") and v30 opens with אִישׁ ("a man"). The row's rationale/observed_substrate_signals claim of sharing no root with "...the sluggard's-field vignette after it" is bytes-false; OL's supporting claim of "zero shared content tokens with 24:30" is the same error, independently disconfirmed by this re-derivation. Separately, rejected_alternative tests only the forward candidate (24:30) and never engages the backward אל-prohibition construction-run rival with 24:28 (both verses open אל + a prohibited speech/testimony verb, both concern wronging a person) -- a construction-run class Prov book strategy §6 recognizes as legitimate cluster glue, so the omission is a real completeness gap, not a strawman. The single_proverb verdict is not itself overturned: 24:29 remains a quoted forbidden speech-act, a distinct register from both neighbors.
rulings.remedy: Edit P10-038's rationale + observed_substrate_signals: remove the false "shares no root ... after it" clause; replace with disclosure of the shared איש root as non-driving cross-seam texture with 24:30 (parallel in form to how P11-004 discloses its own unadopted echo), while keeping the single_proverb boundary on the register ground already in the row (24:29 is quoted forbidden speech, a distinct register from the first-person narrative opening 24:30). Extend rejected_alternative with one added sentence naming and defeating the backward rival: 24:28's אל-prohibition construction-run with 24:29 (both are אל + a prohibited speech/testimony verb; distinguish by content -- false testimony against a third party vs. private retaliation -- or whatever distinguishing evidence the writer wave finds). Field: rationale, observed_substrate_signals, rejected_alternative. Test the cure must pass: independent sweep.py --skel איש filtered to Prov.24.29-24.30 returns non-zero (matches the corrected claim); rejected_alternative names and defeats BOTH the forward (24:30) and backward (24:28) rivals -- the test that killed the original's grounds.

rulings.challenge_claim: Row omits the before-the-king echo into its own closing seam (25:5|25:6) that neighbor P11-004 discloses from the other side.
rulings.grounds: Byte re-derivation (tier-1, oshb:Prov.25.5/Prov.25.6) confirms לִפְנֵי מֶ֑לֶךְ / לִפְנֵי מֶ֑לֶךְ recur byte-identically, cantillation (atnach) included, at the row's own right seam. P11-004 (25:6-25:7) already discloses this exact device in its device_notes as "an unadopted cross-seam echo per the standing cohesion rule," naming Prov.25.5 explicitly. P11-003's rationale, boundary_evidence_refs, and device_notes (read directly in draft_rows_combined.jsonl) contain no mention of 25:6 or this echo. Per the TOOLKIT standing rules ("a byte-true device straddling the row's own seam argues continuity against the row unless disclosed"; "SYMMETRY completion is a SWEEP, not a spot fix ... for ... every disclosure object"), a device already disclosed from one side of a shared seam must be disclosed from the row on the other side too. CONVERGENCE: this is the SAME defect as OL's item on this row (both target the identical undisclosed echo at the identical seam), not a distinct finding; adjudicated together with one remedy.
rulings.remedy: SEAM-PAIR alignment, ONE edit only (Job lesson a): add a device_notes sentence to P11-003 mirroring P11-004's existing wording, e.g. "לִפְנֵי מֶ֑לֶךְ (oshb:Prov.25.5) echoes לִפְנֵי מֶ֑לֶךְ (oshb:Prov.25.6), disclosed as an unadopted cross-seam echo per the standing cohesion rule" -- matched in form to P11-004's own sentence so the pair reads as one consistent disclosure rather than two independently drifting edits. Field: device_notes (boundary_evidence_refs may add oshb:Prov.25.6 as the cited comparator). Do not touch unit_type/confidence/boundary -- this is disclosure-only; the imperative-pair cluster evidence and the address-form distinction from P11-004 are unaffected. Test the cure must pass: re-read of P11-003 and P11-004 together shows the identical לִפְנֵי מֶ֑לֶךְ-class device named in parallel language at both sides of the 25:5|25:6 seam (the symmetry check that exposed the original gap).
